<title level="1" pfs="Standard">[Sweet Hag](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3041)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Sweet hags use bright colors, pleasant visages, and sugary treats to draw in children and the young at heart. Their favorite prey is impoverished youngsters who are unlikely to be missed—sweet hags offer them food and a veneer of kindness before devouring the hapless child. Sweet hags also enchant their food to magically charm others, often using these bespelled servitors to handle all of their busywork. Though they present a lovely and generous face to the world, they turn vicious when insulted or defied. A sweet hag's true form is a dribbling mass of flesh with gumdrop eyes, often resembling melting taffy.

<column gap="tiny">
**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47)): DC 19

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 17

**[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 14
</column>

</column>

<column gap="medium">
<image src="/images/Monsters/Sweet_Hag.webp" />
</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 4">[Sweet Hag](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3041)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Medium" />
<trait label="Hag" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=620" />
<trait label="Humanoid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=628" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 189

**Perception** +10; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59)

**Languages**
[Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=13), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Fey](/Languages.aspx?ID=119), [Jotun](/Languages.aspx?ID=8); [_truespeech_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +9, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +11, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +10, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +8, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +8, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +9

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +5

**Dex** +3

**Con** +3

**Int** +2

**Wis** +2

**Cha** +4
</row>

**[Coven](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=58)** A sweet hag adds [_charm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1463), [_honeyed words_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1558), and [_outcast's curse_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1620) to their coven's spells.

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 21 

**Fort** +11 

**Ref** +11 

**Will** +12 

+1 status to all saves vs. [magic](/Traits.aspx?ID=644)
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 70

</row>

**Weaknesses**
[cold iron](/Equipment.aspx?ID=375) 5

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 25 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
candy cane claw +14 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103)),
**Damage** 1d10+5 piercing plus soporific touch

**Occult Innate Spells** DC 20, attack +14
- **Cantrips (2nd)**
[Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Figment](/Spells.aspx?ID=1528), [Light](/Spells.aspx?ID=171), [Message](/Spells.aspx?ID=190)
- **1st**
[Charm](/Spells.aspx?ID=34) (at will), [Cleanse Cuisine](/Spells.aspx?ID=1468) (at will), [Spider Sting](/Spells.aspx?ID=300)
- **2nd**
[Create Food](/Spells.aspx?ID=52) (sweets only), [Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) (at will), [Laughing Fit](/Spells.aspx?ID=1583), [Shrink](/Spells.aspx?ID=284), [Sleep](/Spells.aspx?ID=288)
- **Constant (5th)**
[Truespeech](/Spells.aspx?ID=1728)

**Betraying Touch** <actions string="Single Action" />  The sweet hag touches a creature that doesn't realize the hag is an enemy. The betrayed creature is affected by soporific strike with a –4 circumstance penalty to their saving throw.

**[Change Shape](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=55)** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), [Polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=127)) The sweet hag can take on the appearance of any Medium [humanoid](/Traits.aspx?ID=628) woman. This doesn't change their Speed or their attack and damage bonuses with their Strikes, but it might change the damage type their Strikes deal (typically to bludgeoning).

**Poisoned Candy** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) The sweet hag casts an innate spell that can normally target 1 creature on a piece of food, typically a sweet treat. The spell is stored in the food. The first creature that eats any of the food is affected by the spell and takes a –4 circumstance penalty to their saving throw against that effect.

**Soporific Touch**  ([Incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) A creature damaged by a sweet hag's claw must succeed at a DC 20 Fortitude save or be [enfeebled 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71) for 1 day. If the creature critically fails or fails this save while already enfeebled by soporific strike, it falls [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) and dreams of eating delicious sweets; this is a [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) [sleep](/Traits.aspx?ID=696) effect. If not woken up before 1 minute passes, the creature wakes up automatically.

</column>
